description: This file defines the DLMClient class, which is a client for interacting with the Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager service, providing methods for managing lifecycle policies and tags via AWS SDK.

classes.name: DLMClient
classes.description: A client class for the Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager service, extending the AWS base client.

methods.name: createLifecyclePolicy
methods.description: Creates a new lifecycle policy in AWS.

methods.name: createLifecyclePolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new lifecycle policy.

methods.name: getLifecyclePolicy
methods.description: Retrieves details for a specific lifecycle policy.

methods.name: getLifecyclePolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a specific lifecycle policy.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
